What is VA CCN Insurance?

blocks.html: The VA Community Care Network (CCN) is used by Veterans who utilize health providers outside the VA. This coverage allows Veterans to receive the care that they need in a timely manner. CCN has a total of 5 regional networks across the United States that work with licensed healthcare providers.
blocks.text: The VA Community Care Network (CCN) is used by Veterans who utilize health providers outside the VA. This coverage allows Veterans to receive the care that they need in a timely manner. CCN has a total of 5 regional networks across the United States that work with licensed healthcare providers.

blocks.html: CCN can provide Veterans with coverage for medical, behavioral health, surgical, dental services, and complementary and integrative health services. Addiction and mental health treatment services would fall within the behavioral health category covered by VA CCN insurance.
